blurb: Discover the vibrant culture, art, and landmarks of Miami on this immersive city tour. Begin at Bayside Marketplace, a bustling waterfront hub, and pass by iconic sites like the Miami Heat Arena and historic Freedom Tower. Wander through the colorful Wynwood Walls, filled with world-class street art, and explore the lively streets of Little Havana, where Cuban heritage comes to life! For an optional upgrade, board the Island Queen Sightseeing Cruise for stunning panoramic views of Miami’s skyline and Biscayne Bay. This carefully curated tour delivers a seamless mix of culture, history, and scenery, offering a complete Miami experience in a single afternoon.
